title: GO:0008276 | protein methyltransferase activity | PTN000378681

author: ValWood
body:
Hi Marc,
I'm sorry, I made a mistake with this one. It's a tandem fusion protein and the N-terminal is indeed a protein methyltransferase based on ortholog to SGD RKM5
note to self, reannotate (see https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21460220/ )
v

It is what I was thinking, but as it is within a duplication, I wondered if you had some information that I did not have. Better no annotation then a wrong annotation. No worries, I can undo the change 😊.
Cheers,
